name: Lantern of the Chained Reaper

source.note: Fabled Heirloom from Maidenmist Cemetery; the book's numbers, our words.

powers.name: Summon Spirit
powers.text: A Ghost steps out of the flame and fights beside you for a minute.

summary: A hooded lantern with a blue-green, fuel-free flame (30 ft bright, 30 dim): +1 to Investigation and Perception (+2 at level 7, +3 at 13). From level 7, Detect Magic and Summon Spirit (a Ghost ally for a minute) once a dusk each; from 13, Scorching Ray three times a dusk and Magic Circle. (Showing the ethereal in its light waits on the engine.)
